spec.expr: sum by (pod, container) (irate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", cluster=~"$cluster", container=~"$container", container!=""}[2m]))
sum by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", cluster=~"$cluster", container=~"$container", container!="", resource="cpu"})
sum by (pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", cluster=~"$cluster", container=~"$container", container!=""})
sum by (pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", cluster=~"$cluster", container=~"$container", container!="", resource="memory"})

irate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container", container!="", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m]) / irate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container", container!="", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m])

max by (container) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{job="kube-state-metrics", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container"} or kube_pod_init_container_status_restarts_total{job="kube-state-metrics", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container"})

spec.title: ⚠️ Rules Exceeding Their Evaluation Interval
spec.description: Rule groups where last evaluation took longer than their configured interval

spec.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(container_fs_reads_bytes_total{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", cluster=~"$cluster", container=~"$container", container!=""}[2m]))
sum by (pod) (-rate(container_fs_writes_bytes_total{pod=~"$pod", namespace=~"$namespace", cluster=~"$cluster", container=~"$container", container!=""}[2m]))

spec.title: Slow Rules
spec.description: Rules taking longer than their interval
